notes.title: Quantum Tripper | Singular Technology | Math
notes.content:
]Today, we celebrate an electrifying milestone that will send shockwaves through the music industry! It has been an awe-inspiring decade since Quantum Tripper's extraordinary journey began, propelling the mystery solo artist (turned solo dev) to the highest echelons of sonic mastery. With a seismic impact, unleashing upon the world the groundbreaking single named Math, ignited a revolution that would forever redefine the boundaries of music.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/2af7713939b470cb98d3bfb31142ab8facda8529.png[/img]

Quantum Tripper also unleashed the inaugural studio album, Technological Singularity. Brace yourselves for an aural odyssey beyond comprehension, as this sonic masterpiece transports you to unimaginable realms of audio euphoria. Each track pulsates with an unstoppable energy, captivating minds and captivating hearts in a sonic vortex of unparalleled creativity, and each track has received a handcraft remix for the full-length [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/71emdqMUToqugr3miIrOnR]record[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/9310ec151456a1107a04092379bf5be14647b323.png[/img]

The 10th Anniversary Remix LP, Singular Technology is an exciting mix of classic and new electronic sounds, layering the vibes of the original release with unique weirdness. Listeners are taken on a journey through a range of genres, from acidic bass lines and off-kilter brain rattles, to soaring synths and immersive atmospherics. With tightly-constructed production that fuses frenetic beats and squelching electronics, this album is the perfect way to celebrate a decade of cutting-edge creativity. This eclectic collection of music is sure to be a hit with fans of all genres, from dubstep and dance music to instrumental hip hop and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/2af7713939b470cb98d3bfb31142ab8facda8529.png[/img]

But there's more! The game has received a heavy dose of updates including new skyboxes, better leaderboards, an a new stage: Math. In this exhilarating new map, you'll find yourself thrust into an electrifying world where you navigate a geometric wonderland, feeling the pulse of adrenaline surge through your veins with every step. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/7fd1377aef75cc8e22d8ce6b38aab40d0b86fdfe.png[/img]

Engage in mind-bending illusions that will push the boundaries of your imagination. The visuals alone will leave you spellbound, as you witness breathtaking psychedelic landscapes that blend reality with the abstract in a mesmerizing dance of colors synchronized to one of the most incredible tracks of the last decade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/6b9ffa6ebda2d0d3bd2965033db7fe504840d74d.jpg[/img]

Today, as we commemorate this momentous occasion, we stand in awe of Quantum Tripper's unrivaled legacy. A decade of pushing boundaries, smashing expectations, and rewriting the very fabric of musical genius. Join us as we pay tribute to the unrivaled passion, unmatched innovation, and unbridled determination. Together, we revel in the breathtaking journey that has propelled Quantum Tripper to stratospheric heights, forever etching its name in the hallowed halls of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2554830/Quantum_Tripper__Math/]psychedelia[/url].

notes.title: Quantum Tripper | New Mode: Balls
notes.content:
- New Mode: Balls! Now you can try every map in this timed, action driven, ball busting, arcade game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/11987469e5fb8cd6f875cb9639d3ed821de6f34b.png[/img]
The objective of this mode is to match the patterns on the ball with the material selector to earn the most amount of synergy. Balls will be destroyed after 3 shots, but points are only earned when a match occurs. Matching artwork onto the canvases will increase the time limit by 10 seconds. The game ends when you run out of time.  Every ball destroyed spawns 2 more balls. Go hard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/142e5548f646a5013f65be265893cd68aa376efc.png[/img]
- Hidden QR Codes! 40 QR codes have been added to the Tourist stage. Scan them with your phone to see stuff. The next major update should shadowdrop on the 10th anniversary of Quantum Tripper, along with a remix LP of the first record. Keep an ear out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/9d518cdf1ce3ab5a742284aa3dbfc68827638d72.png[/img]

notes.title: Win an ultra rare Quantum Tripper CD / Drink Coaster
notes.content:
Did you know that Quantum Tripper merchandise exists in the physical form?  From artwork to musical media Quantum Tripper has been tinkering away, producing some of the most eclectic styles that have seen countless imitations surface in recent years.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/274a1f267cd82d1ab323a895665add27dedd4f3c.jpg[/img]

This holiday season, 3 winners with the best gameplay videos of Quantum Tripper will be given a copy of Quantum Tripper's breakthrough 3rd album "Cellular Triangulation."  The top 2 winners will also receive a copy of the 2nd album, "Conscious Duality."  The first place winner will receive all three CDs, including the debut, "Technological Singularity." All you have to do is make a Let's Play video of one of the DLC levels (Nanofest, Electrocrucify, Trip City, New Number, Voyager, or Wetwash).  You can upload the video to YouTube for easy sharing or an emerging video platform because those are important too.  Just make sure you leave a comment on this post and a link to the video to qualify for the contest.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/d630ede13449f0c156ebde7956c198b7b1e9d842.png[/img]

notes.title: Quantum Tripper v0.6 Launched
notes.content:
Version 0.6 has just dropped featuring two new maps-- Voyager and Wetwash. 
Trips will now be automatically saved mid session when exiting the level from the pause menu.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/89e24c7810081052143044da8be8909a5db5fbae.jpg[/img]

Wordphrases have been localized into Spanish, Portuguese, German, and French.  Texture quality has been bumped up, tunnels have been added to previous maps, menu navigation has been improved, random bugs have been stomped out, and a bunch of other stuff has happened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/78b8384c40617668ad6497628915ed5baaaad636.jpg[/img]

Finishing a level now rewards an unlockable phenomenon that can be applied to all the trips.  Why not find out what each of them do...

notes.title: Version 0.6 Incoming
notes.content:
Major update will drop soon including [b]2 new levels, unlockable content, and the ability to save your trip mid session. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/e267dbd5ebb53a851e4266b7ae56a2ccc99b3f94.png[/img]
The first new stage <<VOYAGER>> takes place deep in the outer reaches of the universe, somewhere near Uranus. <<WETWASH>> revolves around tunnels and washing machines or something, who knows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/968682a01f81e0867630ae99aa019752cc2c1384.png[/img]
The currents levels have been overhauled with higher fidelity textures and extra paths to show off these new trippy elements.  Wordphrases have been localized into 4 additional languages, and you'll now be able to earn psychedelic rewards for finishing the trips.

notes.title: Quantum Tripper | Laser Upgraded
notes.content:
-laser now burns through moving targets, destroying them easily
-better behavior for boxes and saucers
-wallchanger changes with music tempo
-can no longer shoot while paused
-other subtleties 

The laser can be acquired by destroying the 10 throbbing coins and unlocking the magenta door.  Make sure to check out the Steam Guide if you are having any trouble.  For those of you who already unlocked this modifier, this update will already take effect!  Protip:  Shooting the coins while they are inflated will make them easier to shoot after they are dislodged from the wall.
